utterances.text: I need you to talk me out of something. Let's just chat, but here's a little game, the moment I say the word 'cello', jump in and call it out right then. Don't wait for me to finish.
Okay so I left my coffee on the desk this morning and now it's completely cold. I keep doing this.
Yeah, that's annoying. How long was it sitting there?
Maybe two hours. I was focused on some work, trying to learn guitar actually, and just forgot about it.
Guitar, nice. What are you learning?
Just some basic chords. My neighbour plays drums and he's been showing me stuff too, but guitar feels more my speed.
That's a good way to learn, having someone nearby who plays.

Right. I also tried piano once but gave up. Anyway, this morning I was sitting there with my cold coffee thinking, I should really get a thermos. And then I heard my neighbour playing cello through the wall and it was actually kind of beautiful.
